newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures maintain range, end barely lower.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures maintain range, end barely lower.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures ended little changed in extremely thin dealings, ahead of the Florida crop estimates released on Monday, market sources said.
Analysts expect no major changes from the previous U.S. Department of Agriculture report, which put Florida production at 221.2 million 90-lb boxes, and yields at 1.57 gallons per box.

The most-active July contract closed down 0.10 cent at 74.75 cents per lb, having ranged from 75.40 to 74.60 cents. May closed 0.60 higher at 74.00, while the rest of the board ended 0.35 to 0.10 weaker.
July continued to narrow its premium over May, closing 0.75 cent over the spot month, compared with 1.45 on Tuesday.
Volume was estimated at 1,300 lots compared with Tuesday's official 1,392 lots.
Support in July remained at 72.00 cents and resistance at 78.00 cents.
There have been no delivery notices issued to date.
Brazil will release the first estimate of its 1997/98 crop, on May 20.
